entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-26
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Projection of entity with complex collection throws exception #37725
  • In-Memory Corruption of Nested Owned Entities After SaveChanges with Record 'with' Expression #37581
    11.0.0
  • Bug with _tableAliaseMap in EF Core 9 #37682
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #37769
  • FK dependency ordering wrong when replacing an inline owned entity #36059
    11.0.0

Updated

  • Use testcontainer for SQL Server tests by default #33267
    11.0.0
  • EF Core Cosmos generating invalid parameter names for parameterized queries in EF10 when using pattern matched object #37465
  • When using SQL server replication when renaming a column the migration uses `sp_rename` which fails on db update. #37662
    Backlog
  • Add analyzer to guard against ToAsyncEnumerable VS AsAsyncEnumerable #37670
    Backlog
  • Allow moving an entity between collections without deleting its children #30634
    Backlog
  • Allow reparenting owned entities with nested navigations. #36206
    Backlog
  • Complex property stored as json will be marked non-nullable even in TPH class hierarchy #37404
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Default to using SQL Server testcontainer in tests #37809
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37808

Merged

  • Add parameterless overloads for AddPooledDbContextFactory<TContext> #37144
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37806
  • Fix in-memory corruption of nested owned entities after SaveChanges when navigation is replaced #37787
  • Fix FK dependency ordering when replacing row-sharing owned entity #37799
  • [release/10.0] Fix InvalidCastException in OriginalValues.ToObject() with nested nullable complex properties #37703
    Servicing-approved

Updated

  • Fix owned entities with default values not saved in TPH with shared columns #37751
  • [release/10.0] Fix ExecuteUpdate over scalar projections #37791
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.5
  • [release/10.0] Fix invalid SQL parameter names for switch/case pattern-matched variables #37805
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.5
  • Fix NullReferenceException when accessing null complex properties in TPH with shared columns #37695
  • Fix complex property JSON column not marked nullable in TPH hierarchy #37781
  • Add skills #37768
